name: careerforge-backend
description: CareerForge AI Microservices and API Gateway
author: Piyush

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix gateway install && npm --prefix services/auth install && npm --prefix services/resume install && npm --prefix services/interview install && npm --prefix services/roadmap install && npm --prefix services/billing install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm --prefix gateway dev" "npm --prefix services/auth dev" "npm --prefix services/resume dev" "npm --prefix services/interview dev" "npm --prefix services/roadmap dev" "npm --prefix services/billing dev"
scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm --prefix gateway start" "npm --prefix services/auth start" "npm --prefix services/resume start" "npm --prefix services/interview start" "npm --prefix services/roadmap start" "npm --prefix services/billing start"
